items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: Joe was digging down in his pocket for months and months and he had me with him to help look out after his tickets

ctx.x: I used to encourage Louis during them days when he was running with my trumpet player see and I said the day that you can ever get a chance to get out underneath Joe the world's going to hear about you see and he remembers it too and I said because you play much more trumpet than Joe I said but Joe's got to keep you back because he's got to feature himself he's the leader and got to continue to do that I said but the day somebody hey you play by yourself and the stuff that you can get out of that horn you're…
been on top there for quite a while been on top for quite a while he was going
